title: How this draft was checked
body: A session agent drafted the page from the blueprint you approved. A fresh fact-checker read 100 claims against the code: 96 held and 4 were imprecise. The register editor's 26 findings, 8 of them blocking, were applied or declined with a reason. A recheck of the changed lines held 51 of 60, and a finisher fixed the other 9.
Four facts were minted and four extended. The blueprint was brought in line with the settled page afterward, so a later redraft keeps every fix.

title: Keep the title, or make it a task title?
body: The register's heading rule flags a title that opens on an -ing word. This title comes from your approved blueprint and the outline, and the file's slug matches it, so the session kept it. A rename would also change the file name, the outline entry, the track index, and the link from Scaffolded site files.

choices.label: Rename it
choices.done: The session renames the page, its slug, the outline entry, the index, and every link to it, then reruns the gate.

title: Added after approval: the Tailwind exclusion step
body: The reference asks a site to keep Tailwind from scanning `.claude/`, but no step said so. The step is conditional: only a build that uses automatic source detection and doesn't gitignore `.claude/` needs it, and a scaffold already carries it (`tokens.css:55`).

The path resolves against the stylesheet that carries it, so from a stylesheet in `src/` the line is `../.claude`. `cairn-guidance check` looks only for `./.claude`, which from `src/` excludes the wrong directory. The page never repeats that advice, and the diagnosis row says `check` can flag a correct line. The engine defect is BACKLOG #75.

title: Added after approval: clear `.orig` files, then commit
body: The draft had no step that commits the tree, though the CI fix assumed it. `install` tells the reader to read and delete any `.orig` file before committing (`bin.ts:101-103`), so that step comes first, then the commit.

title: Added after approval: the `pre*` scripts caution
body: Merging the snippet's scripts replaces any `precheck`, `prebuild`, or `predev` the site already has, and makes `dev`, `build`, and `check` depend on `@tailwindcss/cli` and `src/admin.css`. `check` warns about neither. The caution says to chain an existing command instead.

title: Edits the page leaves to you
body: The draft said two edits are left to you. The steps hand over more: the import line, the hook, the scripts and workflow where missing, the optional CI gate, the Tailwind exclusion, the `.orig` files, and removable paths. The introduction now lists every one.
